summary: The second session of test fixes worked five of the six rows. The failing package test for AC-BOT-01 was a wrong help contract, not a wrong test. proposal_changed and prerequisite_blocked are outcomes of a continue-with-phases receipt that fails after acceptance, so they moved out of its exit-coded errors into its outcome text, and the test passes. New or strengthened tests cover AC-CHOICE-02, AC-STOP-05, AC-LAST-05 and AC-LAST-03, and each was seen to fail against a break of the behavior it proves. Fresh re-graders put all five rows at Adequate. AC-ITEM-01 (high risk) is still Weak and is the one row left under To fix in test-audit.md. The full suite passed: unit, integration and package. The help contract file is runtime help content, so the implementation changed.
